title: Gilgamesh
oneliner: The oldest surviving story in the world is about a man having a breakdown about mortality..

title: Qin Shi Huang
oneliner: The most powerful man alive drank mercury because someone told him it was the key to eternal life.

title: Luigi Cornaro
oneliner: A dying aristocrat stripped his diet to almost nothing and lived to nearly 100, then wrote books telling everyone else to do the same.

title: Marie Jean Condorcet
oneliner: He wrote humanity's case for immortality while hiding from a death warrant. Two days after being caught, he was dead.

title: Charles-Édouard Brown-Séquard
oneliner: One of the founders of endocrinology injected himself with animal testicles to feel young again. It was placebo.

title: Elie Metchnikoff
oneliner: He said we should live to 150. His own heart killed him at 71.

title: Alexander Bogdanov
oneliner: He believed swapping blood with the young would keep him alive forever. His twelfth transfusion killed him.

title: James Bedford
oneliner: A dying professor bet everything on being frozen, and 59 years later he is still waiting to wake up.
